messages:
deploybot: Starting deploy to prod (us-east-1)
Environment: prod
Release tag: release-2025-03-12
Mode: canary (10%)
Commits in this rollout:
- 7a9f3b2 — kevin — runtime: kv-cache bump, fixes batching (#4123) https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123
- 4c2d1a9 — maria — runtime: guard double-free on model allocator (#4119) https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4119
- d3f6e78 — alex — docs/test cleanup (#4127) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4127
Deploy plan: canary -> monitor 5m -> gradual 100% if no regressions

sarah: quick q — is 4c2d1a9 a behavior change or just safety guard? want to know risk for latency.

kevin: 4c2d1a9 is a safety guard, small alloc fix. latency-neutral in local perf runs.

priyanka: noted. please flag if latency or error rate > 3% vs baseline. If so, pin to previous SHA and rollback. :warning:

ops-monitor-bot: monitoring: canary slot started at 1729991125, routed 120 requests to canary (10%).

deploybot: Canary report (5m window):
- requests: 120
- p95 latency: 162ms (+3ms from baseline)
- errors: 0 (5xx = 0)
- token cost delta: +0.2%
Status: canary OK — proceeding to gradual rollout to 50%.

sarah: thanks. proceeding.

ops-monitor-bot: ALERT: starting 1729991178 — spike detected: increased 5xxs in inference-prod-us-east-1 from 0.0% -> 2.8% over 1m, source: model-serving-gpu-03

kevin: seeing same in logs: stacktrace points to model allocator failure in runtime at 4c2d1a9 path. repeating on canary hosts.

priyanka: 2.8% > threshold. let's pin and rollback. rollback target: prev-sha 5b4a2c1 (prod stable). Can someone kick rollback? @deploybot

deploybot: Rollback initiated -> target SHA: 5b4a2c187c (5b4a2c1 short). Rolling back prod to 5b4a2c187c
Rollback mode: immediate (100%)
Linked commits: reverting commits since 5b4a2c187c

ops-monitor-bot: rollback in flight. routing shifted: 100% -> stable at 1729991186

deploybot: Rollback complete. Prod now at SHA 5b4a2c187c. Summary:
- Duration: 38s
- Reason: 5xx spike traced to runtime allocator changes in 4c2d1a9
- Owner: kevin (author of 7a9f3b2 and reviewer for 4c2d1a9)
- Follow-up: create hotfix branch to isolate allocator fix + stress test on GPU hosts

kevin: taking ownership. will open hotfix PR and a stress test run. sorry folks.

sarah: thanks for fast rollback. please add postmortem notes in the release doc and tag QA for stress tests.

priyanka: we'll pin the release until hotfix validated. tagging this incident for postmortem.

deploybot: Notifying #incidents and creating rollback ticket: https://internal.redwood.dev/tickets/INC-2025-034

sarah: closing thread here, follow-up tracking in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
